me.name: Harith Bairagoni
me.domain: Startups, preferably Series A or Series B; valuation is a consideration.
me.line: I like being thrown into problems without an instruction manual.
me.bio60: From mechanical engineering and plant operations to field research and building products, I like making sense of unfamiliar problems. I co-founded LandSafe and built TidyRow and ColdConnect to simplify spreadsheet cleanup and managing professional connections. I’m looking to bring that approach to a Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff role at a startup.
me.work_intro: Across products, operations, and strategy & growth, I turn unfamiliar problems into practical next steps.

experience.team_line: Property verification connecting field operations, GIS, and legal due diligence.
Engineering, procurement, and contractor workstreams for a ₹152 Cr ethanol facility.
Campaign research, booth-level analysis, and executive briefing notes.
Machining parameter optimization and validation trials.

projects.title: ColdConnect
projects.problem: Keep track of professional connections, prepare relevant questions before meetings, maintain connections through LinkedIn and Gmail follow-ups, and schedule future meetings.
projects.did: Built ColdConnect solo to address my own need to manage professional connections, prepare questions, follow up through LinkedIn and Gmail, and schedule next meetings. Tested the project myself.
projects.brief: Build a tool to track connections, prepare questions, and plan follow-ups.

projects.title: TidyRow
projects.problem: Turn messy spreadsheets into structured data for data analysts who are not tech savvy, including data formatted for HubSpot and Salesforce.
projects.did: Built TidyRow solo, including one-click data formatting for HubSpot and Salesforce. Prioritized ease of use for less technical data analysts. Tested it with real company sales and performance metrics files and included a demo file in the platform. The college project helped me develop how I think about solving a problem.
projects.brief: Build spreadsheet cleanup with one-click formatting for HubSpot and Salesforce.

projects.title: LandSafe Customer Acquisition & Service Delivery
projects.problem: Acquire customers and deliver property verification services for an early-stage venture.
projects.did: Led customer acquisition, sales, and end-to-end service delivery at LandSafe.
projects.number: Generated ₹4 lakh in revenue at an early stage
projects.brief: Generate ₹4 lakh in revenue through customer acquisition, sales, and service delivery.

projects.title: Telangana Campaign Research
projects.problem: Provide constituency research and briefing material to inform campaign strategy.
projects.did: Synthesized intelligence from 15 constituencies, performed booth-level voter analysis, and developed executive briefing notes for ministers and MLCs.
projects.brief: Synthesize research from 15 constituencies to inform campaign strategy and executive briefings.

projects.title: Carbide Tool-Life Optimization Project
projects.problem: Reduce machining expenditure and improve cutting-tool life.
projects.did: Optimized machining parameters using Taguchi Analysis and executed validation trials.
projects.number: Improved cutting-tool life by 30%; reduced manufacturing expenditure by ₹21.8 lakh; increased output from 20 to 25 components per tool cycle.
projects.brief: Improve cutting-tool life by 30% through machining parameter optimization.

projects.title: Legislative Council Nomination Profile Development
projects.problem: Prepare an MLC candidate profile and nomination dossier aligned with statutory requirements.
projects.did: Prepared the MLC portfolio that was sent to the Legislative Council for the formal proceedings of his nomination and approval. Structured life-event documentation and supporting records for the submission.
projects.brief: Prepare an MLC portfolio for formal Legislative Council nomination proceedings.

projects.title: LandSafe Property Due Diligence
projects.problem: Bring documentary checks and physical observations into a structured property review.
projects.did: Coordinated field, GIS, and legal verification workstreams. Supplied a property-review work sample showing title flow, encumbrance history, compliance, physical verification, a review matrix, and recommendations.
projects.brief: Bring records, site observations, and next actions into a structured property review.
